{"code": "import pandas as pd

# Load the data
df = pd.read_csv('data/sales.csv')

# Check for sentinel values in customer_age
print(f"Number of -1 values in customer_age: {(df['customer_age'] == -1).sum()}")
print(f"Total rows: {len(df)}")

# Check revenue column type and example values
print(f"Revenue dtype: {df['revenue'].dtype}")
print(f"First 5 revenue values: {df['revenue'].head().tolist()}")

# Check for QA orders (revenue = 999999.99)
qa_orders = df[df['revenue'] == '999999.99']
print(f"Number of QA orders: {len(qa_orders)}")

# Check for refunded orders
refunded = df[df['status'] == 'refunded']
print(f"Number of refunded orders: {len(refunded)}")

# Check channel and customer_segment distribution
df.groupby(['channel', 'customer_segment']).size().reset_index(name='count')"}
